findings.title: dcfg_wo_number column does not exist
findings.detail: Template fields reference dcfg_wo_number but column DOES NOT EXIST on dcfg_contract. Correct column is dcfg_contract_number.

findings.title: dcfg_contract_value column does not exist
findings.detail: Template fields reference dcfg_contract_value but column DOES NOT EXIST. Correct column is dcfg_contract_fee.

findings.title: dcfg_msa.dcfg_msa_number does not exist
findings.detail: dcfg_msa_number DOES NOT EXIST on dcfg_msa. Use dcfg_msa.dcfg_name instead.
findings.fix: Remap to dcfg_msa.dcfg_name or create the column

findings.title: 5 vendor columns from wrong entity model
findings.detail: These are Contact/Account entity columns, not dcfg_vendor columns.

findings.title: Highlight matching uses strict equality
findings.detail: f.sourceText === accText fails when highlighted area has offset text. Azure Function normalizes; SPA does not.
findings.fix: Normalize both sides (trim, collapse whitespace) or use contains-check

findings.title: MSA expand missing from contract re-fetch
findings.detail: Contract re-fetch at generate time does not $expand dcfg_msa_id. All dcfg_msa.* paths resolve to null.

findings.title: Vendor signer reads vendor record, user edits go to contract record
findings.detail: Template: dcfg_vendor.dcfg_signer_name. Composer writes: dcfg_signer_printed on contract. User edits lost.
findings.fix: Remap template to contract columns or write user edits to vendor

findings.title: Customer signer reads customer record, user edits go to contract record
findings.detail: Template: dcfg_customer.dcfg_primary_contact_name. Composer writes: dcfg_owner_contact on contract.
findings.fix: Remap template fields to contract columns with fallback

findings.title: Parent contract expand uses wrong navigation property name
findings.detail: RELATION_MAP maps dcfg_wo to dcfg_parent_contract_id. Correct nav prop is dcfg_contract_parent.

findings.title: decades_handler composite has empty parts
findings.detail: Parts are hardcoded empty strings. Always produces blank.
findings.fix: Wire to dcfg_configs or account handler lookup

findings.title: No UI for start_date, end_date, schedule, service description (WO)
findings.detail: ContractComposer has no input fields. Also dcfg_work_hours vs dcfg_schedule_description naming split.

findings.title: Duplicate template: Decades Work Order vs Decades Workorder
findings.detail: Two active templates with same type 100000006, no customer filter. Auto-resolve picks arbitrarily.
